top.line: An agent team turned the European brain article into a Mistral site overnight, with 33 browser demos.

in-short.line: Overnight, 33 demos, models together, a scam note only Large 4 caught, 41 cents, alignment.

overnight.line: From 22:51 to 08:30, for the Mistral Vibe Hackathon in London; version 0.1.0 to 0.1.20.

team.line: A conductor, a research agent with 73 sourced facts, demo and design agents, capped sessions, a security agent.

studio.line: A shoebox to a website, a document to a newsroom page, Ministral in the tab with no key.

workflows.line: Agents drawn as they run: five Mistral models on one brief, an X-ray of the site's own claims.

evals.line: 19 cases, three tries: only Large 4 caught a hidden scam note; the evals corrected themselves.

swarm.line: The Swarm on Mistral: signed packets, 65 of 67 checks, valid first answers on the storm tasks.

security.line: Nine key pages reviewed: key in one tab variable, two endpoints only, strict policies, no remembering.

corrected.line: The research corrected four claims in the European brain article: training, EU processing, retention, partners.

cost.line: About 41 cents of Mistral usage; the Claude sessions cost far more.

alignment.line: European, open weights, edge models, an EU endpoint: a natural default, and a proposal next.

limits.line: Nothing agreed; no EU key or Pi measured; Chromium only; small evals.

sources.line: The Mistral provider site, its repository and the Mistral pages it cites, on 21 November.
